feature_definition.source: The two immediately preceding draws' six main numbers only; bonus numbers are excluded.
feature_definition.overlap_count: Count the shared main numbers between draws t-2 and t-1.

state_components.overlap_count_bin: 0 if overlap_count==0; 1 if overlap_count==1; 2 if overlap_count>=2

feature_definition.distance: Hamming distance across the one frozen categorical overlap-count component.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=3..t-1, use the overlap-count state of draws u-2 and u-1 as the feature and the six main numbers of draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draws t-2 and t-1, then add target t only after scoring.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.

estimator.conditional_count: Weighted count of each main number in historical transition outcomes.
estimator.global_rate: Count of each main number in draws 1..t-1 divided by t-1.

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E068 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.
portfolio.line_order: Line 1, then line 2, then line 3, each selected from the remaining unused numbers.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.
